method.name: Integer Linear Programming with PuLP + CBC
steps: Define X, Y as integer LpVariables with lower bound 0
Extract optimal solution (X*, Y*) and objective value (minimum total cost)

rationale: Small 2-variable integer program with linear constraints — direct ILP with CBC is the standard approach, verified on similar budget-allocation planning tasks (orarla_1, orarla_2). HiGHS backend is known to fail on this class.
